items.q: in fact Herbie Mann told me one day, and -- in Dakar, Africa, we were rehearsing and I was playing like Miles

ctx.x: But you have to dig down into the

bowels of the -- of what these guys are doing. To get -- see what they're trying -- they know what they're doing. They know what they're trying to do and they know where -- so many of us will not understand it, will not get it. But I listen to Miles, I've always listened to Miles. And I get something out of his -- in fact Herbie Mann told me one day, and -- in Dakar, Africa, we were rehearsing and I was playing like Miles, and he said you sound like Miles Davis. I got a big kick out of it, because I can imitate…
